item_name: Rothco USMC Dog Tag Key Chain
item_short_desc: Rothco’s USMC Dog Tag Key Chain features the USMC Crest on a durable stainless steel dog tag with an easy to use attached key ring. USMC and the Marines globe and anchor logo is printed on the front of the dog tag in gold lettering. This USMC key chain is a simple way to show off your Marine Corps pride and makes for a perfect gift or accessory.
